articles.summary: New sponsorship expands NetApp’s presence across the NFL, delivering trusted data, intelligence, and the ability to perform in critical moments NetApp® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, today announced that they have been named an Official Partner of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. This new relationship builds on NetApp’s status as the Official Intelligent Data Infrastructure Partner of the NFL, helping the league and its teams quickly and confidently access, manage, and activate their data. The Buccaneers will leverage NetApp technology to support the experience for Buccaneers fans in the stadium on game days and beyond. “NetApp will serve as a trusted technology partner that will help us elevate the customer experience for all Buccaneers fans,” said Buccaneers Chief Commercial Officer Atul Khosla. “Reliable and secure access to data plays an essential role in the overall game day experience at Raymond James Stadium. articles.summary: Enterprises can now migrate attached storage and database workloads directly to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with AWS Transform NetApp ® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) today announced that AWS Transform now supports Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, making it even easier for enterprises to move applications and data to AWS. articles.title: NetApp and AWS Accelerate Storage Migrations with AWS Transform

articles.summary: NetApp (NASDAQ: NTAP) will hold their 2026 INSIGHT™ customer conference in Las Vegas, Nevada on September 29 – October 1, 2026. On Tuesday, September 29, 2026, NetApp will host a technology session for financial analysts and investors from 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time. The event will include George Kurian, Chief Executive Officer; Syam Nair, Chief Product Officer; Wissam Jabre, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and several tech specialists discussing NetApp’s differentiation and value proposition in the areas of enterprise storage, AI, cloud transformation, data infrastructure modernization, and cyber resilience. Kris Newton, Vice President, Investor Relations, will moderate a customer panel. Furthermore, NetApp will also host a keynote session of mainstage headliners from 9:00 – 10:15 a.m. Pacific Time which will include special tech luminaries, industry leaders and entertainment icons. How to Participate Live video webcasts of both events will be available
articles.title: NetApp Hosts Technology Sessions at 2026 INSIGHT Conference in Las Vegas, Nevada
